ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel values covering approximately 95% of the visible area, with sparse, high-intensity (white/light) focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary uniform dark-gray/black pigment across both lobes. Secondary spatial mapping consists of scattered, high-contrast white circular blobs and rings (rosettes) distributed non-uniformly across the ventral surface, with higher concentrations on the medial-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 42 degrees; vertical depth is approximately 18% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude along the entire trailing edge. Distal regions exhibit extreme jaggedness and multiple deep, irregular indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex upward sweep from the median notch, terminating in sharp, highly irregular distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of circular, high-contrast white-ringed pixel clusters (barnacle scars) scattered across both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, short-duration horizontal linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the left lobe, roughly mid-way between the peduncle and the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe structural erosion and multiple jagged 'missing' segments at both distal tips, with the right tip exhibiting a particularly fragmented, multi-peaked profile.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme degree of terminal edge fraying creates a unique shredded silhouette on the outer margins of both lobes.
